'''2007 Yavin 4 Regionals Scott Lingrell DS Let Them Make The First Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Scott Lingrell]] at [[2007 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Let Them Make The First Move / At Last We Will Have Revenge|Ref3-D-letthemmakethefirstmove.gif}}
